title: Rabbah bar Beruna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 110a: the question was asked what “palm water” is. Rabbah bar Beruna said: “There are two palm trees in the West, and a spring of water comes out between them. The first cup loosens; the next one purges.”
Hyman explains that Yuchasin’s statement that he was Rav’s student refers to Rav Beruna, his father.
